fields.mechanism: Multi-point structural reinforcement system with distributed stress absorption
fields.intervention: Redesign pacemaker lead with additional reinforcement segments at critical stress points and distributed viscoelastic material to absorb mechanical stress during patient movement and cardiac contractions
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in lead fractures and disconnections that may cause unexplained adverse events by preventing mechanical failure under dynamic physiological conditions
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated mechanical testing of reinforced leads versus standard leads under simulated physiological conditions including flexion, torsion, and pressure changes
fields.mechanism_source_span: As implantation volumes continue to increase worldwide, device-related complications have emerged as significant determinants of patient outcomes, healthcare utilization, and long-term prognosis. Pacemaker-related complications demonstrate substantial heterogeneity in terms of temporal onset, underlying pathophysiological mechanisms, and clinical impact.

fields.mechanism: Passive structural monitoring system for lead integrity without active electronic components
fields.intervention: Incorporate passive structural indicators into pacemaker lead design that provide visual or tactile feedback on lead integrity without requiring electronic monitoring
fields.expected_effect: Enable detection of lead structural issues without introducing new electronic failure modes that could contribute to adverse events without identified device problems
fields.falsification_test: Compare long-term performance and complication rates between standard pacemaker leads and leads with passive structural indicators in a controlled clinical trial

fields.mechanism: structured lifecycle-based risk management framework integrating complication prevention across the entire continuum of pacemaker therapy
fields.intervention: implementing a comprehensive risk management protocol that includes structured preprocedural assessments, standardized intraoperative techniques, and longitudinal postprocedural surveillance specifically for pacemaker lead implantation
fields.expected_effect: reduction in unexplained adverse events by systematically identifying and addressing potential failure points throughout the device lifecycle
fields.falsification_test: compare complication rates between patients receiving standard care and those treated with the lifecycle-based risk management protocol over a 3-year period
fields.mechanism_source_span: "This review proposes a structured lifecycle-based risk management framework that integrates complication prevention across the entire continuum of pacemaker therapy. This approach highlights the dynamic nature of complication risk across different phases of device therapy. Within this lifecycle risk-management paradigm, complication prevention should extend beyond isolated perioperative measures and encompass structured preprocedural assessments, standardized intraoperative techniques, and longitudinal postprocedural surveillance"

fields.mechanism: A lifecycle-based risk management framework that integrates complication prevention across the entire continuum of pacemaker therapy
fields.intervention: Implement a comprehensive monitoring system that combines acoustic sensing to detect lead dislodgement with thermal monitoring to detect tissue interface changes
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of lead complications before they result in adverse events without identified device problems
fields.falsification_test: Compare complication rates in patients with standard pacemaker leads versus those with the hybrid acoustic-thermal monitoring system over a 5-year period

fields.expected_effect: Reduction in unexplained adverse events by identifying and addressing potential lead failure mechanisms at each phase of therapy before they result in injury
fields.falsification_test: Compare incidence of "adverse event without identified device" in patients receiving lifecycle-based monitoring versus standard care over a 5-year period
